command:
set -euo pipefail
R=/workspace/omega_runtime
STATE=$R/state
CUR=$R/current
OLD=$(readlink -f "$CUR")
NEW=$R/releases/093e470c5c06e3568fda535f081be7f1dcd30035-sigma-cortex-retina-v1-candidate-003
OLD_PID=$(cat "$STATE/omega-supervisor.lock")
proc_live() { local p="$1"; [ -r "/proc/$p/stat" ] || return 1; local s; s=$(awk '{print $3}' "/proc/$p/stat" 2>/dev/null || true); [ -n "$s" ] && [ "$s" != Z ]; }
nonz_matching() { ps -eo pid=,stat=,args= | awk -v old="$OLD" '$2 !~ /^Z/ && index($0,old)>0 && index($0,

)>0 {print $1}'; }
test "$OLD" = "/workspace/omega_runtime/releases/a676258885b964efc2a80599957dc1c09dc3d43b-full-777-v1"
test -d "$NEW"
python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib,sqlite3,sys
db=pathlib.Path('/workspace/omega_runtime/data/omega_unified.db')
if db.exists():
 c=sqlite3.connect(f'file:{db}?mode=ro',uri=True)
 try:
  if c.execute("select 1 from sqlite_master where type='table' and name='relay_ledger'").fetchone():
   n=c.execute("select count(*) from relay_ledger where state in ('DISPATCHING','UNKNOWN')").fetchone()[0]
   if n: raise SystemExit('ACTIVE_OR_UNKNOWN_RELAY_PRESENT:'+str(n))
 finally:c.close()
PY
CMD=$(tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$OLD_PID/cmdline)
case "$CMD" in *omega.supervisor_outer*"$OLD"*) ;; *) echo "OLD_SUPERVISOR_IDENTITY_MISMATCH:$OLD_PID:$CMD" >&2; exit 41;; esac
rollback() {
  set +e
  echo 'ROLLBACK_BEGIN'
  if [ -f "$STATE/omega-supervisor.lock" ]; then
    P=$(cat "$STATE/omega-supervisor.lock" 2>/dev/null || true)
    if [ -n "$P" ] && proc_live "$P"; then kill -TERM "$P" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
  fi
  sleep 3
  ln -sfn "$OLD" "$CUR.next" && mv -Tf "$CUR.next" "$CUR"
  # Start old runtime only when no non-zombie old supervisor remains.
  if ! ps -eo stat=,args= | awk -v old="$OLD" '$1 !~ /^Z/ && index($0,

)>0 && index($0,old)>0 {found=1} END{exit(found?0:1)}'; then
    nohup env PYTHONPATH="$OLD" OMEGA_RUNTIME_ROOT="$STATE" OMEGA_REPO_ROOT="$OLD" OMEGA_UNIFIED_DB="$R/data/omega_unified.db" python3 -m omega.supervisor_outer --runtime-root "$STATE" --repo-root "$OLD" >> "$STATE/logs/supervisor.rollback.log" 2>&1 </dev/null &
  fi
  sleep 5
  echo 'ROLLBACK_DONE'
}
trap 'rc=$?; if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then rollback; fi; exit $rc' EXIT
kill -TERM "$OLD_PID"
for i in $(seq 1 100); do
  if ! proc_live "$OLD_PID"; then break; fi
  sleep 0.25
done
if proc_live "$OLD_PID"; then
  # Relay is proven quiescent above; terminate the stuck supervisor only, then verify children drain.
  kill -KILL "$OLD_PID"
  sleep 1
fi
for i in $(seq 1 60); do
  LEFT=$(nonz_matching | tr '\n' ' ')
  [ -z "$LEFT" ] && break
  sleep 0.25
done
LEFT=$(nonz_matching | tr '\n' ' ')
if [ -n "$LEFT" ]; then echo "OLD_NONZOMBIE_PROCESSES_REMAIN:$LEFT" >&2; exit 42; fi
ln -sfn "$NEW" "$CUR.next"
mv -Tf "$CUR.next" "$CUR"
test "$(readlink -f "$CUR")" = "$NEW"
nohup env PYTHONPATH="$NEW" OMEGA_RUNTIME_ROOT="$STATE" OMEGA_REPO_ROOT="$NEW" OMEGA_UNIFIED_DB="$R/data/omega_unified.db" python3 -m omega.supervisor --runtime-root "$STATE" --repo-root "$NEW" >> "$STATE/logs/supervisor.sigma.log" 2>&1 </dev/null &
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,pathlib,time,sys
state=pathlib.Path('/workspace/omega_runtime/state')
new='/workspace/omega_runtime/releases/093e470c5c06e3568fda535f081be7f1dcd30035-sigma-cortex-retina-v1-candidate-003'
required={'assembly','grid','relay','receipt_reconciler','telemetry','master_bridge'}
last=None
for _ in range(100):
 try:
  s=json.loads((state/'SUPERVISOR_STATUS.json').read_text()); last=s
  ch=s.get('children',{})
  if s.get('schema')=='OMEGA_SUPERVISOR_STATUS/v3' and s.get('repo_root')==new and required.issubset(ch) and all(ch[k].get('alive') is True for k in required):
   p=json.loads((state/'ASSEMBLY_PREFLIGHT.json').read_text())
   if p.get('preflight_ok') is True and p.get('static_core_bound') is True: break
 except Exception: pass
 time.sleep(.5)
else:
 print(json.dumps({'error':'NEW_SUPERVISOR_NOT_HEALTHY','last':last},sort_keys=True),file=sys.stderr); raise SystemExit(43)
last_grid=None
for _ in range(100):
 try:
  g=json.loads((state/'STATUS.json').read_text()); last_grid=g
  if isinstance(g.get('cortex'),dict) and (state/'cortex_state'/'STATE.json').exists(): break
 except Exception: pass
 time.sleep(.5)
else:
 print(json.dumps({'error':'CORTEX_LIVE_STATUS_MISSING','last_grid':last_grid},sort_keys=True),file=sys.stderr); raise SystemExit(44)
assert not (state/'cortex_runtime.sqlite3').exists()
print(json.dumps({'pass':True,'current':str(pathlib.Path('/workspace/omega_runtime/current').resolve()),'supervisor_schema':s.get('schema'),'supervisor_pid':s.get('pid'),'children':{k:ch[k] for k in sorted(required)},'assembly_preflight':{'preflight_ok':p.get('preflight_ok'),'static_core_bound':p.get('static_core_bound')},'grid_cortex':g.get('cortex'),'no_second_cortex_db':True},sort_keys=True))
PY
trap - EXIT
echo LIVE_SWITCH_PASS
